name: Hepatic Cystic Hamartoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Radiologic and Histopathologic Diagnostic Criteria for Hepatic Cystic Hamartoma

criteria.description: Presence of multiple small cystic lesions within the liver on imaging studies
Histopathological identification of irregularly shaped bile duct-like structures embedded in fibrous stroma
No evidence of malignant transformation or invasive carcinoma

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic cystic lesions on imaging plus confirmatory histopathology demonstrating bile duct hamartomatous structures
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often incidental; biopsy recommended if malignancy cannot be excluded

pathognomonic.symptomName: Multiple small hepatic cystic lesions detected radiologically
searchTerms: multiple small liver cysts on scans

pathognomonic.symptomName: Histopathological presence of malformed bile duct structures within fibrous stroma
searchTerms: abnormal bile duct structures in liver tissue
malformed bile ducts seen on biopsy

common.symptomName: Incidental detection during imaging for unrelated conditions

occasional.symptomName: Jaundice due to bile duct obstruction
searchTerms: yellow skin due to bile obstruction
mild increased pressure in liver veins

occasional.symptomName: Fatigue related to mild liver dysfunction
searchTerms: low energy due to liver issues

rare.symptomName: Spontaneous cyst rupture with abdominal pain
searchTerms: sudden cyst rupture causing belly pain

laboratory: Mildly elevated alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST)
Normal to mildly elevated alkaline phosphatase
Normal bilirubin unless bile duct obstruction present
imaging: Ultrasound: multiple small hypoechoic cystic lesions scattered throughout liver
CT scan: multiple small, well-defined cystic lesions without solid components
MRI: T2 hyperintense cystic lesions with no enhancement post-contrast
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; sporadic occurrence
other: Histopathology: irregular bile duct-like structures embedded in fibrous stroma consistent with hamartoma

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of papillary projections on imaging

redFlags: Rapid increase in size of hepatic cystic lesions
Onset of jaundice or cholestatic liver enzyme pattern
Evidence of solid components or mural nodules within cysts on imaging
references: Schnelldorfer T. Hepatic cystic lesions: diagnosis and management. Surg Clin North Am. 2010;90(2): 331-346.
Kawamoto S, et al. Imaging features of biliary hamartomas (von Meyenburg complexes). AJR Am J Roentgenol. 2002;179(4): 1033-1037.
